messages:
ana: opened a PR to tweak quantization routing + KV cache heuristics to cut token cost on chat workloads — would appreciate a quick review when you have a sec
ana: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1290 :link: summary in the description
ci-bot: GitHub checks queued for PR 1290
jess: :eyes: can you paste the perf numbers here? curious about tail latency for long contexts
ana: quick summary from microbench (4xA100, median over 200 requests)
ana: baseline (q4f16, no pref routing, naive cache): 1.20s / req
ana: changes (adaptive routing + kv-prefetch + q4f16-auto): 0.82s / req -> ~32% latency drop, ~22% token cost savings in our trace
ana: snippet of the config change in the PR:
ana: ```
runtime:
  quantization: q4f16
  kv_cache:
    mode: auto
    prefetch_threshold: 16
  routing:
    prefer_local_variant: true
    max_fallback_latency_ms: 250
```
ana: perf is best for 2k-4k contexts. for 8k contexts latency is 2.6s -> 2.45s (marginal regression in worst-case latency, but cost still down ~8%)
sahil: thanks — did you run the regression eval on our long-chat prompt set? any hallucination signal changes?
ana: ran eval set `evals/chat-long-2025-11` — no measurable quality diff in top-1 tokens (BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxy). added the eval artifact in the PR description
jess: sounds promising. any incompat with existing pinned model flavors? worried about customers pinning older variants
ana: no breaking changes. routing is opt-in behind a feature flag `runtime.routing.adaptive_v1` and we keep the old behavior as a fallback. added migration notes to CHANGELOG
ryan: happy to review — will check tests + perf artifacts. can you add a quick perf run in CI job (small smoke) so we don't regress on merges?
ana: done — added `perf-smoke` job to the PR pipeline (runs lightweight 50q trace)
pr-bot: build passed for PR 1290
jess: pinging @sahil @ryan for approvals. if both OK, we should canary to prod-dedicated for 6h then rollout
sahil: will take a look today, aiming to get review by EOD :thumbsup:
ryan: on it, will leave comments if anything blocks. if clean, we can schedule a 6h canary tomorrow morning
ana: thanks team! happy to pair on any follow-ups. :rocket:
